text:
Alex G: quick note from staging runs: routing looks inconsistent for the new 'cheap' variant. some requests land on cheap but the console shows no cheap metrics. anyone got ideas?
Marta P: can you dump the request headers and sample trace id? maybe the attribute extractor isn't picking it up.
Alex G: trace id `tb-0847`, header sent was `x-route-meta: variant=cheap;run=staging-0847` (from py-sdk v0.15.2).
Samir K: that's likely it. we changed SDK header output to lowercase earlier this week (canonicalization). infra expects `X-Route-Meta` (Pascal) in several places.
Irene L: ugh. so the router's header matcher is case-sensitive? that's fragile.
Samir K: currently router does a direct map lookup on header names coming from the proxy. the proxy preserved original case previously, but recent proxy normalizer lowercases keys. mismatch path is: sdk(lowercase) -> proxy(lowercase) -> router(map expects Pascal) -> no match -> fallback variant. console ingester later indexes whatever variant the router emitted.
Marta P: options: A) make router header matching case-insensitive; B) have proxy add canonical pascal header duplicates; C) push SDKs to emit Pascal by default.
Alex G: for immediate relief we should do A in router (fast), and C as long-term.
Samir K: agree. implement case-insens lookup in router: change headerMap := make(map[string]string) to normalize via strings.ToLower for keys and do lookups likewise. small code change, low risk, but will add a canary.
Irene L: create incident? if staging is affected we should block releases until we fix.
ops-bot: incident 17498 created (routing-header-case-mismatch). responders: eng-oncall, eng-platform.
Marta P: SDK change note: let's add a compatibility flag REDWOOD_HEADER_FORMAT with values preserve|pascal|lower. default to preserve for one release to avoid surprising users. Add docs in devex when we flip.
Samir K: propose TS/Go/Py patch PRs: add env var and a unit test asserting header key casing behavior. example py change: ```python
style = os.getenv('REDWOOD_HEADER_FORMAT', 'preserve')
key = 'X-Route-Meta' if style == 'pascal' else 'x-route-meta'
headers[key] = serialized_meta
```
Marta P: also add an integration smoke that asserts console metric equals router-decided-variant per trace id. that'll catch regressions during deploys.
Alex G: i'll add the assertion to the smoke harness and re-run after router canary.
Samir K: router canary started (deploy-9001). will monitor.
ops-bot: deploy deploy-9001 to canary started.
ops-bot: deploy deploy-9001 to canary succeeded.
Alex G: canary shows both header casings matched now, cheap variant metrics appear in console for the tb-0847 traces. re-running full smoke.
Marta P: when SDK PRs are up, ping devex and product for migration notes and console mapping change. also consider a one-off backfill for the last 48h of runs in staging if needed.
Irene L: i'll file a console backfill ticket and link incident 17498.
Samir K: timeline: router case-insensitive lookup -> canary now -> prod rollout tomorrow morning; SDKs: PRs today, RC tomorrow, docs update before default flip.
Alex G: thanks all. will post final smoke result in 30m. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident 17498 marked as resolved (investigation complete)
